effects.printed_clause: Discard 1; Special Summon a Level 4 or lower "Arckcestial" from Deck in Defense, then LIGHT Spellcaster-only Special Summon lock; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Ignition discards as cost, summons the filtered Deck monster in Defense, and registers the lock through end turn under id HOPT.

official_references.matched_structure: Archetype Deck Special Summon with rest-of-turn restriction.

effects.printed_clause: If sent to GY as Synchro Material for a LIGHT monster: target a banished "Arckcestial", add it, then discard 1; HOPT.
effects.lua_implementation: Delayed EVENT_BE_MATERIAL confirms REASON_SYNCHRO and LIGHT reason card, targets a face-up removed Arckcestial, accounts for whether the returned card can itself be discarded, then adds and discards; separate HOPT.

coverage_override.reason: The discard/Deck Summon/LIGHT Spellcaster lock and the Synchro-material recovery/then-discard trigger are the two distinct compound effects, each including its HOPT.
